Essere una forza per il bene e aiutare a nutrire una generazione più sana

Come polimeccanico: in EFZ a Nestlé Nutrition & Health, la vostra missione è quella di mantenere e migliorare le strutture meccaniche e le infrastrutture nel nostro centro di ricerca e sviluppo a Konolfingen. Si ottiene qualcosa lavorando a stretto contatto con colleghi di ingegneria, team tecnici e partner di produzione. Questa è la vostra opportunità per espandere la vostra esperienza e ottenere risultati significativi che migliorano la vita attraverso le innovazioni nutrizionali in tutto il mondo.

È così che si agisce come un polimeccanico: in EFZ qualcosa

• Manutenzione di attrezzature meccaniche e infrastrutture per supportare il funzionamento sicuro e affidabile.

• Migliorare le macchine e le attrezzature per migliorare le prestazioni e l'affidabilità a lungo termine.

• Fornire supporto tecnico nelle prove per aiutare i team a raggiungere risultati di successo.

• Fabbricazione e adattamento di parti di precisione in acciaio inox, metallo e plastica per soddisfare le esigenze operative.

• Macchine di prova necessarie per confermare funzionalità, sicurezza e disponibilità operativa.

• Supporta servizi di localizzazione e standby tecnico per garantire che le attività critiche continuino senza intoppi.

Questo ci convincerà

• Si porterà un'approfondita conoscenza pratica nella manutenzione meccanica e ottimizzazione degli impianti, compresi gli strumenti di macchina controllati dal computer.

• È possibile applicare con successo le competenze nella produzione e adattamento dei componenti in acciaio inossidabile e di altre parti di precisione.

• Userete una forte capacità organizzativa e un ambiente di lavoro autonomo per gestire efficacemente le priorità tecniche.

• Una cooperazione costruttiva con i colleghi: donne con una forte consapevolezza della sicurezza.

• Conoscenza fluida della lingua inglese e della buona conoscenza del lavoro tedesco.

• Si mostra coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, tradurre idee in misure con effetti misurabili e creare valore aggiunto condiviso.

Questo vi aspetta nel nostro processo di applicazione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di applicazione inclusivo e rispettoso e provvederemo volentieri ad adattamenti adeguati, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con strutture e procedure moderne che garantiscono un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di applicazione di solito include un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e un'intervista finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande non appena vengono ricevute e chiudiamo la posizione non appena è stata trovata una buona selezione di candidati rilevanti. Pertanto, si consiglia di applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate come riservate.

Restare vigili: Nestlé contatta i candidati esclusivamente attraverso gli indirizzi e-mail aziendali ufficiali e non richiede pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi momento durante il processo di applicazione.

Pronti a fare bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora la vita e il pianeta.

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

As a polymechanic: in EFZ at Nestlé Nutrition & Health, your mission is to maintain and improve the mechanical facilities and infrastructure at our research and development center in Konolfingen. You achieve something by working closely with colleagues from engineering, technical teams and production partners. This is your opportunity to expand your expertise and achieve meaningful results that improve life through nutritional innovations around the world.

This is how you act as a polymechanic: in EFZ something

• Maintenance of mechanical equipment and infrastructure to support safe and reliable operation.

• Improve machinery and equipment to enhance performance and long-term reliability.

• Provide technical support in trials to help teams achieve successful results.

• Manufacture and adaptation of precision parts made of stainless steel, metal and plastic to meet operational requirements.

• Testing machines as needed to confirm functionality, safety and operational readiness.

• Support location services and technical standby to ensure critical activities continue smoothly.

This will convince us

• You will bring in-depth practical knowledge in mechanical maintenance and plant optimization, including computer-controlled machine tools.

• You successfully apply expertise in the production and adaptation of stainless steel components and other precision parts.

• You will use strong organisational capacity and a self-employed working environment to manage technical priorities effectively.

• A constructive cooperation with colleagues: women with a strong security awareness.

• Fluent knowledge of German and good working knowledge of the English language.

• You show courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, translate ideas into measures with measurable effects and create shared added value.

This awaits you in our application process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful application process and will gladly provide appropriate adjustments if necessary. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern facilities and procedures that ensure a safe environment for all.

The application process usually includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final interview and offer. We review applications as soon as they are received and close the position as soon as a good selection of relevant candidates has been found. Therefore, we recommend that you apply early. All information shall be treated as confidential.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contacts candidates exclusively through official company email addresses and does not require payments or sensitive personal information at any time during the application process.

Ready to do good?

Apply now and accelerate the change that improves life and the planet.

jobs.title: Packaging Development Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months, full-time
Start date: January/February 2027
Deadline for applications: 14 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Packaging Development Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee (NPTC Coffee), your mission is to support the development and industrialization of innovative packaging solutions for the Nescafé Dolce Gusto business. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with packaging experts, project managers, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in packaging development while contributing to projects that improve sustainability, performance, and cost efficiency.

How you’ll make an impact as a Packaging Development Intern

• Support the industrialization and evaluation of new packaging materials for strategic Nescafé Dolce Gusto projects.

• Participate in laboratory activities, pilot line trials, and packaging testing to validate technical solutions.

• Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturing partners to assess packaging performance and support implementation activities.

• Lead or contribute to technical discussions with suppliers and prepare test reports and project presentations.

• Help drive packaging innovation by supporting projects focused on material optimization, sustainability, and cost reduction.

What will make you successful

• Recent graduate or currently completing a Master's degree in Packaging, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, or a related field

• Knowledge of polymer materials and sealing technologies, with a genuine interest in packaging development and industrialization

• Strong analytical skills combined with attention to detail and systems thinking. Knowledge of SPSS software is a plus

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with cross-functional and international stakeholders

• Proactive, agile and independent mindset with a willingness to learn and collaborate on projects

• Fluent English (written & spoken)

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Come Packaging Development Intern presso il Nestlé Product Technology Centre Coffee (NPTC Coffee), la vostra missione è di supportare lo sviluppo e l'industrializzazione di soluzioni di imballaggio innovative per il business Nescafé Dolce Gusto. Farete la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con esperti di packaging, project manager, fornitori e partner di produzione. Questa è la vostra opportunità per acquisire esperienza pratica nello sviluppo del packaging, contribuendo a progetti che migliorano la sostenibilità, le prestazioni e l'efficienza dei costi.

Come fare un impatto come un Packaging Development Intern

• Sostenere l'industrializzazione e la valutazione di nuovi materiali di imballaggio per progetti strategici Nescafé Dolce Gusto.

• Partecipa a attività di laboratorio, prove di linea pilota e test di imballaggio per convalidare soluzioni tecniche.

• Collabora con fornitori e partner di produzione per valutare le prestazioni di imballaggio e sostenere le attività di implementazione.

• Condurre o contribuire a discussioni tecniche con i fornitori e preparare report di prova e presentazioni di progetto.

• Aiuta a guidare l'innovazione del packaging sostenendo progetti focalizzati sull'ottimizzazione dei materiali, sulla sostenibilità e sulla riduzione dei costi.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Recenti laureati o attualmente completando un Master in Imballaggio, Scienza dei materiali, Ingegneria dei polimeri, o un campo relativo

• Conoscenza dei materiali polimerici e delle tecnologie di tenuta, con un autentico interesse per lo sviluppo dell'imballaggio e l'industrializzazione

• Forte capacità analitiche combinate con attenzione ai dettagli e ai sistemi di pensiero. La conoscenza del software SPSS è un plus

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interfunzionali e internazionali

• Proattivo, agile e indipendente con la volontà di imparare e collaborare a progetti

• Inglese fluente (scritto e parlato)

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Applicare ora e trasformare il vostro potenziale in qualcosa di straordinario.

jobs.description:

Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Deadline for application: 31 July 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As an Associate R&D Specialist System Performance at Nestlé, your mission is to drive the capability of Nestlé's in-home portioned systems, such as Nespresso and Nescafé Dolce Gusto, to consistently deliver the perfect cup and user experience. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Front End Innovation, Development and Industrialization teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate R&D Specialist System Performance

• Driving system performance to deliver consistent cup quality and an excellent user experience across beverage systems.

• Building science-based understanding of machine, product and packaging interactions to optimize design decisions.

• Leveraging models, data analysis and digital tools to accelerate learning beyond physical testing.

• Providing clear physical explanations of system phenomena to support confident technical decisions.

• Contributing to troubleshooting, root cause analysis and commissioning support to enable successful project delivery.

• Strengthening cross-functional collaboration and competitive benchmarking to support innovation and continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of physics, fluid mechanics and beverage system performance to solve complex technical challenges.

• Applying a science-based mindset to understand interactions between machine, product and packaging.

• Using data analysis, modelling and digital tools, including R or Python, to generate insights and guide decisions.

• Collaborating across product, packaging and machine teams with curiosity, openness and a hands-on approach.

Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, eine Kraft für das Gute zu sein?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und beschleunigen Sie Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Konolfingen , Suisse
Modèle de travail: Sur place / À temps plein 100%
Type / durée du contrat: Permanent

Être une force pour le bien et aider à nourrir une génération plus saine

En tant que spécialiste principal de la fabrication, votre mission est de diriger le soutien à la fabrication pour les projets d'innovation et de rénovation, en fournissant une expertise technique et opérationnelle qui permet une industrialisation réussie et des performances durables en usine. Dans notre centre de recherche et développement à Konolfingen, en Suisse, nous développons des produits, procédés et emballages de nutrition éprouvés par la science, tout en fournissant un soutien technique aux usines de Nestlé dans le monde entier. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes de recherche et développement, les entreprises, les marchés, les usines, les fournisseurs et les partenaires externes. C'est l'occasion de développer votre expertise et d'aider à améliorer la vie grâce à l'innovation nutritionnelle dans le monde entier.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que spécialiste principal de la fabrication

• Diriger le soutien manufacturier dans tous les projets d'innovation et de rénovation pour transformer les concepts prometteurs en produits, processus et systèmes compétitifs

• Conduire les intrants de fabrication précoce, l'évaluation des risques et les décisions techniques qui améliorent la préparation, la rapidité et la qualité de la mise en oeuvre

• Fournir une assistance technique fiable pendant l'industrialisation, les start-ups et les lancements de produits afin d'atteindre des performances industrielles efficaces et durables

• Bâtir et documenter des connaissances spécialisées, des normes et des lignes directrices qui renforcent les capacités de fabrication dans tous les sites

• Explorer des technologies et des processus révolutionnaires qui créent de nouvelles possibilités d'innovation, de productivité et d'avantage concurrentiel

• Développer les connaissances de l'usine par la formation, le coaching et les réseaux qui accélèrent l'apprentissage et la collaboration trans-site

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une expertise en matière de fabrication, d'ingénierie ou de développement de produits à l'industrialisation et au soutien des usines

• Appliquer les normes actuelles de qualité, de sécurité et d'hygiène pour offrir des solutions robustes et durables

• Utiliser l'analyse des données, les outils numériques et la résolution structurée des problèmes pour identifier les risques et améliorer les performances

• Collaborer entre les fonctions, les sites et les cultures tout en communiquant clairement les recommandations techniques à divers publics

• Communiquer couramment en anglais

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé ne communiquera qu'avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à être une force pour le bien?

Appliquer maintenant et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète.

Panoramica della posizione

Lieu : Romont, Switzerland

Entità : Centro di produzione Nespresso

Percentuale : Tempo pieno 100%

Scoprite le nostre professioni: Professioni Nespresso - YouTube

Nel ruolo di Operatore/trice logistico/a (M/F/D), sarai responsabile della gestione degli impianti dell’area logistica di produzione (centro di raccolta dei rifiuti e distribuzione dei pallet) con orario di lavoro su turni 4*8.

- Eseguire e documentare i controlli di qualità
- Gestire i rifiuti
- Rifornire le linee con materiale d’imballaggio
- Assicurarsi della corretta applicazione del 5S
- Fornire supporto alle linee di produzione

I vostri punti di forza per avere successo

- CFC in ambito logistico o esperienza equivalente
- Patentino per carrellista
- Esperienza nell’industria agroalimentare o farmaceutica
- Padronanza del francese
- Padronanza degli strumenti informatici standard (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)

- 5 settimane di ferie
- Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo interni

- Politica favorevole alla genitorialità
- Ristorante aziendale in loco con menu a prezzi agevolati

- Numerosi vantaggi presso il Club Nespresso

All’interno di un team eterogeneo che riunisce più di 90 nazionalità in 58 Paesi, puoi partecipare a questa cultura innovativa, nella quale le persone si sostengono e si aiutano a vicenda. Una cultura nella quale ciascuno è incoraggiato a mettere in discussione lo status quo e ad avere un impatto sul futuro di una delle più grandi aziende sostenibili al mondo. Qualunque sia il ruolo che ricoprirai, scoprirai che puoi davvero cambiare le cose e condividere il tuo entusiasmo. Unisciti a noi in questo luogo dove potrai realizzarti, trovare un senso di appartenenza e l’ispirazione per diventare la versione migliore di te stesso e superare te stesso.

Nespresso culture

At Nespresso, we have built a culture founded on kindness and inclusion, where everyone can be themselves while growing with the company. Within a diverse team bringing together more than 90 nationalities in 58 countries, you can take part in this innovative culture, in which people support and help one another. A culture in which everyone is encouraged to challenge the status quo and have an impact on the future of one of the world's largest sustainable companies. Join this place where you can thrive, find a sense of belonging and the inspiration to become the best version of yourself and surpass yourself.

Werden Sie Teil des Nespresso-Teams! Und denken Sie die Natur des Kaffees neu. Denken Sie Ihre Zukunft neu.

Kurzübersicht zur Stelle

Lieu : Romont, Switzerland

Einheit: Nespresso-Produktionszentrum

Beschäftigungsgrad: Vollzeit 100%

Vertragsart: Unbefristeter Vertrag

Was wir bei Nespresso bieten

- Echte Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung
- Ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld, das Kreativität und Zusammenarbeit fördert
- Eine Kultur, die auf Wertschätzung und Inklusion basiert und in der alle sie selbst sein können
- Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit im Mittelpunkt unserer Identität sowie eine zentrale Vision zur Förderung eines positiven Wandels
- Die Möglichkeit, für ein als B Corp zertifiziertes Unternehmen und eine der weltweit vertrauenswürdigsten und beliebtesten Marken zu arbeiten

Entdecken Sie unsere Linkedin-Seite: Nespresso Produktionszentren

Entdecken Sie unsere Berufe: Berufe bei Nespresso - YouTube

Stellenzusammenfassung

Als Logistik-Operator:in (M/W/D) sind Sie für die Bedienung der Anlagen im Produktionslogistikbereich (Entsorgungsstelle und Palettenverteilung) im 4*8-Schichtsystem verantwortlich.

Ein Tag im Leben eines/einer Logistik-Operator:in (M/W/D)

- Die Anlagen im Logistikbereich bedienen
- Qualitätskontrollen durchführen und dokumentieren
- Abfälle verwalten
- Die Produktionslinien mit Verpackungsmaterial versorgen
- Die korrekte Anwendung von 5S sicherstellen
- Die Produktionslinien unterstützen

Ihre Stärken für Ihren Erfolg

- EFZ in einem logistischen Bereich oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
- Staplerführerschein
- Erfahrung in der Lebensmittel- oder Pharmaindustrie
- Beherrschung der französischen Sprache
- Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Computerprogrammen (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)

Vorteile

- 5 Wochen Urlaub
- Möglichkeit zur internen Weiterbildung und Entwicklung
- Pensionskasse mit hervorragenden Arbeitgeberbeiträgen
- Finanzielle Beteiligung an der Krankenversicherung
- Vorteilhafte Regelungen für Eltern
- Betriebsrestaurant vor Ort mit bezuschussten Menüs
- Kostenlose Parkplätze und Ladestationen für Elektroautos
- Zahlreiche Vorteile im Club Nespresso

Nespresso-Kultur

Bei Nespresso haben wir eine Kultur aufgebaut, die auf Wertschätzung und Inklusion beruht und in der jeder so sein kann, wie er ist, während er gleichzeitig mit dem Unternehmen wächst. Wir innovieren, wagen es, neue Dinge auszuprobieren, lernen und entwickeln uns in einem digitalen und vernetzten Umfeld weiter, in dem sich alles sehr schnell entwickelt. Als Teil eines vielfältigen Teams mit mehr als 90 Nationalitäten in 58 Ländern können Sie an dieser innovativen Kultur teilhaben, in der sich die Menschen gegenseitig unterstützen und helfen. Eine Kultur, in der jeder dazu ermutigt wird, den Status quo infrage zu stellen und die Zukunft eines der größten nachhaltigen Unternehmen der Welt mitzugestalten. Welche Rolle Sie auch übernehmen werden, Sie werden feststellen, dass Sie wirklich etwas verändern und Ihre Begeisterung teilen können. Werden Sie Teil dieses Ortes, an dem Sie sich entfalten, Zugehörigkeit finden und Inspiration schöpfen können, um Ihr Bestes zu geben und über sich hinauszuwachsen.

jobs.description:
Division « Eau » du groupe Nestlé, Nestlé Waters (Suisse) SA est le leader suisse du marché des eaux minérales avec des marques telles que Henniez, S. Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier et Acqua Panna, ainsi que d’autres grandes marques de boissons sans alcool. Nestlé Waters Suisse forme une vingtaine d’apprentis par année.

Apprentissage d’opérateur/trice de machines automatisées

août 2026 – juillet 2029

Nestlé Waters (Suisse) SA, Henniez

Résumé de la position

• Nous offrons un environnement d’apprentissage stimulant et varié pour obtenir ton CFC et une bonne formation pour ton avenir

• L’apprentissage se fait dans notre toute nouvelle siroperie, sur la ligne de production ainsi que dans notre laboratoire

• Très bon encadrement par des formateurs qualifiés

• Différents avantages : chèques REKA, demi-tarif train offert, rabais fitness, bons Henniez, rabais Nestlé Shop, cours à l’interne (informatique, gestion du stress, postulation)

• Six semaines de vacances

• Salaires attractifs

Un jour dans la vie d’un/e apprentie/e opérateur/trice de machines automatisées

• Travail sur les lignes d’embouteillage et conduite d’une ou plusieurs machines

• Contrôles réguliers des machines et des produits durant le processus de production

• Respect de toutes les mesures de sécurité et des bonnes pratiques de fabrication

• Réalisation de la maintenance courante des installations et aide au dépannage pour rétablir la production au plus vite

• Maintien des installations et de l’environnement propres

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Fin de scolarité obligatoire avec de bons résultats en maths

• Sens technique et habilité manuelle

• Être prêt/e à travailler en horaire d’équipe plus tard

• Capable de supporter des conditions de travail avec du bruit et de la chaleur

• Langue maternelle française

Tu cherches un apprentissage varié avec une bonne ambiance de travail ? N’hésite pas à postuler!

jobs.title: Demand & Supply Planner

titleByLocale.it: Pianificatore di domanda e di alimentazione

jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Nestlé Waters, Switzerland, Henniez

Permanent Contract

80-100%

Position summary

In this role, you will provide Nestlé Waters with the 18-month rolling best estimate of Customer Demand and improve Demand Plan accuracy. Furthermore, you will manage supply of finished products at different warehouses and manage the finished goods produced by co-packers. The main goal will be to enhance the Supply Chain responsiveness in fulfilling customer demand at optimal cost.

A day in a life of a Demand & Supply Planner:

• Ensure supply & availability of products to fulfil deliveries on time, at the right place with the correct freshness at warehouse level

• Use appropriate statistical models and parameters, interpret results to generate accurate base demand forecasts

• Drive fast, appropriate actions to minimize the impact of deviations from the Demand Plan, and communicate the implemented actions to the stakeholders

• Capture, prioritize, analyze and input Generating Demand events; customer, consumer & competitor information

• Provide Generating Demand teams with inputs on a regular basis regarding product launches, portfolio optimization, rationale of commercial decisions, promotions and customer behaviour

• Build and maintain good communication and collaboration within both Supply Chain and Generating Demand, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, in order to deliver and satisfy our customers at optimal costs

• Support different processes within Supply Chain

What makes you successful:

• University Degree with previous internships performed ideally in Supply Chain or Commercial CFC with maturity or equivalent level with at least two years’ experience in a similar position or relevant operational experience in Supply Chain at market/business level

• Strong analytical skills

• Good communication and collaboration skills to deal with different departments (Marketing, Factory, Transport)

• Fluent in French & English any other languages is a plus

• Good command of Excel and SAP experience

• Acquisizione, priorità, analisi e input Generando eventi della domanda; cliente, consumatore e informazioni concorrenti

Positionsübersicht

In dieser Funktion stellen Sie Nestlé Waters die 18-monatige beste Schätzung der Kundennachfrage zur Verfügung und verbessern die Genauigkeit des Bedarfsplans. Darüber hinaus verwalten Sie die Lieferung von Fertigprodukten in verschiedenen Lagerhallen und verwalten die von Co-Packern produzierten Fertigwaren. Das Hauptziel wird es sein, die Reaktionsfähigkeit der Lieferkette bei der Erfüllung der Kundennachfrage zu optimalen Kosten zu verbessern.

Ein Tag im Leben eines Demand & Supply Planers:

• Sicherstellen der Lieferung und Verfügbarkeit von Produkten, um die Lieferungen pünktlich am richtigen Ort mit der richtigen Frische auf Lagerebene zu erfüllen

• Verwenden Sie geeignete statistische Modelle und Parameter, interpretieren Sie die Ergebnisse, um genaue Basisnachfrageprognosen zu erstellen

• Schnelle, angemessene Maßnahmen zur Minimierung der Auswirkungen von Abweichungen vom Bedarfsplan und Kommunikation der umgesetzten Maßnahmen an die Stakeholder

• Erfassung, Priorisierung, Analyse und Eingabe Generierung von Nachfrageereignissen; Kunden-, Verbraucher- und Wettbewerberinformationen

• Generierende Nachfrageteams regelmäßig mit Inputs in Bezug auf Produkteinführungen, Portfoliooptimierung, Begründung kommerzieller Entscheidungen, Promotions und Kundenverhalten

• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung einer guten Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit sowohl in der Lieferkette als auch bei der Generierung von Nachfrage, Fertigung, Qualität und Finanzen, um unsere Kunden zu optimalen Kosten zu liefern und zufrieden zu stellen

• Unterstützen Sie verschiedene Prozesse innerhalb der Supply Chain

jobs.title: Marketing ROI Insight Expert
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: 18-months Temporary contract

Start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a MROI Insights Expert at Nestlé Global Marketing Analytics , your mission is to turn advanced marketing effectiveness analytics into clear, actionable insights that help markets optimize media, trade and marketing investment. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Marketing Analytics, technology teams, local marketing, media and consumer insight teams, zone leads, global media and finance partners. This is an opportunity to help shape and elevate a growing global function, build marketing effectiveness capabilities across the business, and make an impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a MROI Insights Expert

• Leading the translation of marketing mix modelling, statistics and analytics into simple, compelling insights that shape strategic brand and investment decisions.

• Building clear insight stories, recommendations and business cases that help local teams, zones, SBUs and brand teams improve marketing return on investment.

• Facilitating workshops and presentations with local markets, BEOs, zone marketing teams, Nespresso and global stakeholders to translate insights into action.

• Partnering with the data science team to validate modelling outputs, understand the value behind the analysis and identify opportunities to enhance the capability over time.

• Driving adoption of global marketing effectiveness solutions by partnering with markets, zones and global teams across diverse business contexts.

• Supporting capability development by creating learning content and practical guidance that help business teams use marketing effectiveness insights with confidence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in marketing analytics, marketing effectiveness and marketing mix modelling within an agency, advertiser or global business environment.

• Applying a clear understanding of marketing, media, pricing and promotion models to turn complex analysis into practical business recommendations.

• Using advanced presentation, spreadsheet and business intelligence tools to create insight-led stories for senior stakeholders.

• Showing initiative, autonomy and flexibility in a fast-moving environment, while taking ownership and responsibility for delivering high-quality outcomes.

• Looking for opportunities to improve, contributing new ideas and generating trust through strong collaboration, transparency and teamwork.

• Communicating fluently and confidently in English, with the ability to present clear insights to senior stakeholders.

At Nestlé Switzerland, we care about our people.

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig barrierefrei und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit modernen Einrichtungen und Prozessen, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

jobs.description:

Arbeitsmodell: Aussendienst | 80 bis 100 %
Vertragsart / Dauer: Unbefristet

Ein Ort, an dem Sie tun können, was Sie lieben. Und lieben, was Sie tun.

Als Tierarztberater/in (Vet Advisor) bei Purina besteht Ihre Mission darin, eine veterinärmedizinische Fürsprache und Empfehlung für die Sortimente Pro Plan Veterinary und Pro Plan Maintenance aufzubauen. Sie machen den Unterschied, indem Sie eng mit Tierarztpraxen sowie den lokalen Commercial- und Brand-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in praxisnahe Empfehlungen, Schulungen und Lösungen zu übersetzen. Das ist Ihre Chance, das Leben von Haustieren, der Menschen, die sie lieben, und unseres gemeinsamen Planeten zu bereichern.

So werden Sie als Tierarztberater/in etwas bewegen

•
Aufbau vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu Tierärztinnen und Tierärzten, um die Empfehlung und Nutzung der Purina Pro Plan Sortimente nachhaltig zu stärken.

•
Übersetzung wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse und klinischer Evidenz in praxisnahe Empfehlungen und Schulungen für Tierarztpraxen.

•
Identifikation und Priorisierung von Chancen innerhalb des Gebiets, um den größtmöglichen Mehrwert für Tiergesundheit und Geschäftserfolg zu schaffen.

•
Entwicklung gemeinsamer Erfolgspläne mit Tierarztpraxen, Meinungsbildnern und relevanten Stakeholdern zur Förderung nachhaltiger Partnerschaften.

•
Nutzung von Markt- und Kundeninsights zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung von Aktivitäten und Ergebnissen.

•
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Commercial-, Marketing- und weiteren funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Förderung von Wachstum und Kundenerfolg.

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Fundiertes wissenschaftliches Verständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe veterinärmedizinische Inhalte verständlich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, um Tierärztinnen und Tierärzte zu begeistern und zu überzeugen.

• Strukturierte Herangehensweise an Gebietsplanung, um Chancen zu erkennen und Prioritäten wirkungsvoll zu setzen.

• Erfahrung in der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit sowie ein datenorientierter Ansatz, um Kundenbeziehungen und Ergebnisse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englisch- oder Französischkenntnisse.

• Leidenschaft für Haustiergesundheit und Interesse an Tierernährung; Kenntnisse im Bereich Heimtierernährung sind ein Plus.

Bei Purina finden Sie eine Welt, in der Ihre Fähigkeiten, Ihr Wissen und Ihre Leidenschaft wachsen können.

Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges und ausgewogenes Leistungspaket, das Ihr Wachstum und Ihr Wohlbefinden bei der Arbeit und im Leben unterstützt:

• Flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten

• Bezahlte Urlaubstage über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere voranzubringen

• Leistungsbezogener Bonus

• Beitrag an die Gesundheitskosten und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag an Ihren Pensionskassenplan

• Grosszügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Unterstützungsangebote für Familien

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie in unserem Recruiting Prozess erwartet

Nestlé ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Falls erforderlich, stellen wir Ihnen während Ihres Bewerbungsprozesses gerne angemessene Unterstützung bereit. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Unser Arbeitsplatz ist vollständig barrierefrei, mit stufenlosem Zugang, Aufzügen zu allen Etagen und barrierefreien Toiletten. Zudem pflegen wir eine ausgeprägte Sicherheitskultur, unterstützt durch moderne Anlagen und Verfahren, um für alle ein sicheres Umfeld zu gewährleisten.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel eine Sichtung der Unterlagen, ein Video-Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Hiring Team sowie ein abschliessendes Gespräch und Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen laufend und schließen die Stelle, sobald eine starke Auswahl geeigneter Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten identifiziert ist. Daher empfehlen wir eine frühzeitige Bewerbung.

Bereit, das zu tun, was Sie lieben und zu lieben, was Sie tun?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil einer Bewegung, die eine bessere Welt für Haustiere und Menschen schafft.

Ubicazione: Area di applicazione intorno a Berna e Zurigo e visite individuali a La Tour-de-Peilz

Modello di lavoro: servizio campo / tempo pieno 80 al 100%
Tipo di contratto / Durata: Perpetuo

Un posto dove puoi fare quello che ami. E ama quello che fai.

In qualità di Consulente Veterinario/Vet Advisor di Purina, la vostra missione è quella di costruire un forte advocacy veterinaria e una raccomandazione per le gamme di Manutenzione Pro Plan Veterinary e Pro Plan. Si fa la differenza lavorando a stretto contatto con le pratiche veterinarie e i team locali commerciali e di marca per tradurre prove scientifiche in protocolli, formazioni e decisioni di portata pratica. Questa è la tua occasione per arricchire la vita degli animali domestici, le persone che li amano e il nostro pianeta comune.

Quindi farai la differenza come consulente veterinario / in / Vet Advisor

• Costruire una cooperazione forte e basata sulla fiducia con i veterinari. Ogni interazione viene tradotta in chiare fasi successive che velocizzano la raccomandazione dei range di Pro Plan.

• Tradurre la scienza veterinaria e le prove cliniche in protocolli pratici di pratica e formazioni efficaci che influenzano le scelte nutrizionali.

• Promuovere e privilegiare il vostro campo di pratica per dedicare tempo e competenze in cui è possibile ottenere il massimo impatto sulla salute animale e il successo aziendale.

• Sviluppare piani di successo pratici insieme a campioni e leader di opinioni chiave, nonché il coordinamento dei partner rilevanti per accelerare l'introduzione e la fedeltà.

• Acquisire informazioni sul servizio sul campo e le esigenze del cliente in CRM e tradurli in azioni successive e risultati misurabili utilizzando dashboard.

• Coordinamento stretto con il team commerciale per consentire la crescita di categoria nelle pratiche attraverso una pianificazione forte, un'implementazione coerente e un miglioramento continuo.

Questo li rende di successo.

• Laurea in medicina veterinaria e conoscenza approfondita della nutrizione veterinaria per discutere in modo sicuro le indicazioni cliniche e consigliare soluzioni adeguate.

• Forte capacità di presentazione e capacità di eseguire la formazione tecnica.

• Pianificazione di aree strutturate e gestione degli stakeholder per concentrarsi sulle pratiche giuste, decisori e influencer.

• Collaborazione trasversale e flusso di lavoro guidato dai dati – utilizzando intuizioni CRM per migliorare la qualità dell'interazione e dei risultati.

• Comunicazione fluida in tedesco e inglese; Buona conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio.

• Le qualità centrali di Purina portano alla vita – come passione, ritmo, progresso, spirito pionieristico, scopo e orgoglio.

A Purina, troverete un mondo in cui le vostre abilità, conoscenze e passione possono crescere.

Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivo ed equilibrato che supporta la crescita e il benessere sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per promuovere la tua carriera

• Bonus di prestazione

• Contributo ai costi sanitari e accesso al programma di assistenza dei dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al piano del fondo pensione

• Generoso congedo parentale e servizi di supporto completo per le famiglie

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi nel nostro processo di reclutamento

Nestlé è un datore di lavoro inclusivo. Se necessario, saremo lieti di fornirvi il supporto appropriato durante il processo di applicazione. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate come riservate.

Il nostro posto di lavoro è completamente accessibile – con accesso senza scalini, ascensori a tutti i piani e toile accessibile
descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Area of application around Bern and Zurich as well as individual visits to La Tour-de-Peilz

Working model: field service / full-time 80 to 100%
Type of Contract / Duration: Perpetual

A place where you can do what you love. And love what you do.

As a Veterinary Advisor/Vet Advisor at Purina, your mission is to build a strong veterinary advocacy and recommendation for the Pro Plan Veterinary and Pro Plan Maintenance ranges. You make the difference by working closely with veterinary practices and local commercial and brand teams to translate scientific evidence into practice-relevant protocols, trainings and decisions. This is your chance to enrich the lives of pets, the people who love them and our common planet.

So you will make a difference as a veterinary advisor / in / Vet Advisor

• Building a strong, trust-based cooperation with veterinarians. Each interaction is translated into clear next steps that speed up the recommendation of the Pro Plan ranges.

• Translating veterinary science and clinical evidence into practical practice protocols and effective trainings that influence nutritional choices.

• Profiling and prioritizing your field of practice to devote time and expertise where you can make the greatest impact on animal health and business success.

• Develop practical success plans together with champions and key opinion leaders as well as coordination of relevant partners to accelerate introduction and loyalty.

• Capture field service insights and customer needs in CRM and translate them into next-best actions as well as measurable results using dashboards.

• Close coordination with the commercial team to enable category growth in practices through strong planning, consistent implementation and continuous improvement.

This makes them successful.

• Bachelor’s degree in veterinary medicine as well as in-depth knowledge in veterinary nutrition to safely discuss clinical indications and recommend suitable solutions.

• Strong presentation skills and ability to perform technical training.

• Structured area planning and stakeholder management to focus on the right practices, decision-makers and influencers.

• Cross-functional collaboration and data-driven workflow – using CRM insights to improve the quality of interaction and outcomes.

• Fluent communication in German and English; Good knowledge of French is an advantage.

• Purina’s central qualities bring to life – such as passion, pace, progress, pioneering spirit, purpose and pride.

At Purina, you will find a world where your skills, knowledge and passion can grow.

We offer a competitive and balanced benefits package that supports your growth and well-being at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond the legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to advance your career

• Performance bonus

• Contribution to healthcare costs and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension fund plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive support services for families

• Attractive employee discounts on various products and services

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As an Associate R&D Specialist in Lipids & Metabolic Analytics department at Nestlé Research, your mission is to provide scientific expertise in advanced lipid analytics to help developing, validating and transferring fit-for-purpose analytical methodologies to support product innovation. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, experts, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD with recognized expertise in lipid analysis using advanced-analytics based on mass spectrometry techniques (HRMS and MS/MS) with 1-3 years of expertise in the domain.

• Collaborating with a quality-focused, proactive and curiosity, agility and creativity across research and technology.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, esperti, partner di innovazione e team tecnici in Nestlé. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come specialista R&D associato a Lipids Analytics

• Le principali attività di progetto con indipendenza, accuratezza e rigore scientifico per soddisfare obiettivi e tempi definiti.

• Organizzazione delle attività dei laboratori e realizzazione di esperimenti che coinvolgono partner interni o esterni.

• Guidare l'implementazione di metodi analitici e soluzioni tecniche che migliorano le capacità di analisi dei lipidi nei nostri siti di Nestlé Operation in tutto il mondo.

• Rafforzare le prove scientifiche sui lipidi per sostenere l'innovazione innovativa.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un dottorato con competenze riconosciute nell'analisi dei lipidi utilizzando analisi avanzate basate sulle tecniche di spettrometria di massa (HRMS e MS/MS) con 1-3 anni di esperienza nel dominio.

• Sfruttando le esigenze operative e aziendali e il pensiero di ricerca per sviluppare, convalidare e trasferire metodi analitici idonei a sostenere l'innovazione dei prodotti.

• Collaborare con una qualità focalizzata, proattiva e curiosità, agilità e creatività attraverso la ricerca e la tecnologia.

• Apporter un doctorat avec une expertise reconnue en analyse des lipides à l'aide d'analyses avancées basées sur les techniques de spectrométrie de masse (HRMS et MS/MS) avec 1-3 ans d'expertise dans le domaine.

• Tirer parti des besoins opérationnels et commerciaux et de la réflexion de recherche pour élaborer, valider et transférer des méthodes d'analyse adaptées à l'usage afin de soutenir l'innovation de produits.

• Collaborer avec une recherche et une technologie axées sur la qualité, proactive et la curiosité, l'agilité et la créativité.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

Véritable référent technique, vous assurerez la fiabilité des systèmes d’automation, participerez aux dépannages et contribuerez au développement des outils digitaux qui soutiennent nos opérations au quotidien.

• Diagnostiquer les pannes et participer activement aux interventions sur le terrain.

• Assurer le support et le développement des outils digitaux de l’usine (MES, SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, POKA, etc.).

• Garantir la fiabilité des échanges de données entre les équipements de production, les systèmes de supervision et les applications digitales.

• Assurer le rôle d’administrateur FAS (Factory Automation System) du site.

• Maintenir à jour la documentation technique, les standards et les équipements critiques.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• CFC d’Automaticien(n), Électronicien(n) ou formation jugée équivalente avec expérience dans un environnement industriel

• Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques ; une expérience avec SAP, MES, Power BI, Power Apps ou POKA constitue un atout.

• Esprit d’analyse, autonomie et orientation solutions.

• Goût pour le travail de terrain et la résolution de problèmes techniques.

• Excellentes capacités de collaboration et de communication.

• Français courant ; anglais technique un atout.

Nestlé Waters (Switzerland) is the Swiss leader in the mineral water market with brands such as Henniez, S.Pellegrino, Vittel, Contrex, Perrier and Acqua Panna, as well as other leading brands of alcohol-free beverages.

Place of work: Henniez

Type of contract: Permanent contract

Work rate: 80%-100%

As an Automatician & Digital Specialist, you will play a key role in the proper functioning of our production facilities and in the digitization of the factory. True technical reference, you will ensure the reliability of automation systems, participate in troubleshooting and contribute to the development of digital tools that support our daily operations.

One day in the life of an Automatician & Digital Specialist

• Ensure the proper functioning and reliability of plant automation systems.

• Diagnosing breakdowns and participating actively in field operations.

• Improve programs, equipment and systems to optimize production line performance.

• Develop preventive maintenance and contribute to the continuous improvement of equipment.

• Participate in the installation, start-up and commissioning of new equipment.

• Ensure support and development of factory digital tools (MES, SAP, Power BI, Power Apps, POKA, etc.).

• Ensure reliable data exchange between production equipment, supervisory systems and digital applications.

• To act as the FAS (Factory Automation System) administrator of the site.

• Maintain technical documentation, standards and critical equipment.

What Will Make Your Success

• SWCs (n), Electrician(n) or equivalent training with experience in an industrial environment

• Knowledge of Siemens automation and industrial networks.

• Interest in new technologies, automation and industrial digitalisation.

• Good control of computer tools; experience with SAP, MES, Power BI, Power Apps or POKA is an asset.

• Spirit of analysis, autonomy and orientation solutions.

• Taste for field work and solving technical problems.

• Excellent collaboration and communication capabilities.

• Current French; technical English an asset.

Lieu : stages disponibles sur nos 3 centres de production (Romont / Avenches / Orbe)

Reimagine what coffee can be. Reimagine what you can become.

En tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Production et/ou Logistique + Amélioration Continue , vous étudiez, proposez et prenez en charge la mise en place d’une structure d’amélioration continue inspirée de TPM (Total Performance Management) sur des lignes de production ou en zone logistique.

Comment aurez-vous un impact en tant que Stagiaire Ingénieur-e Production et/ou Logistique + Amélioration Continue ?

• Analyser les tendances des indicateurs de performance de sa zone (fiabilité, arrêts planifiés, arrêts mineurs, pertes, blocages, …) afin d’initier des démarches de résolution de problèmes ou des projets d’améliorations et prendre les actions nécessaires pour atteindre les objectifs
• Assurer l’interface entre la production et ou logistique et les différents départements et garantir le suivi, la mise en place et la communication des actions d’améliorations de sa zone
• Coordonner les activités d’amélioration continue, de TPM et de digitalisation entre les équipes et coacher dans l’analyse et la résolution des problèmes récurrents
• Assurer la mise à jour des procédures et standard et garantir leur application

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Etudiant-e en école d’Ingénieur-e
• Connaissance des outils d’amélioration continue et/ou TPM
• Expérience dans l’industrie agro-alimentaire (un atout)
• Capacité d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes
• Capacités à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire
• Aisance en communication.

Avantages

• 5 semaines de vacances

• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur
